findings.reason: The original text renders cleanly, but this multi-interface definition benefits materially from a concrete diagram separating the encoder/decoder path from the source-reconstruction distortion comparison. This is an authorized explanatory-diagram omission, not a failure of the existing formulas.
findings.action: Added a final Remarks illustration with code maps, their input/output blocks, and a separate block-distortion comparison; separately restated the two operational criteria.

correction: Added a mathematically checked operational fixed-length code diagram and explanatory Remarks without changing the original definition or any frontmatter. Bounding-box padding prevents lower formula clipping in the native compiler.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: Source block X^n in mathcal X^n, encoded message f_n(X^n) in [M_n], and reconstructed block hat X^n in hat mathcal X^n.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Definition line 35 supplies f_n: mathcal X^n -> [M_n], g_n: [M_n] -> hat mathcal X^n and hat X^n=g_n(f_n(X^n)); the two rightward arrows apply exactly these maps in this order.

diagram_math_checks.relation: The two lower arrows carry the source and reconstruction as the two arguments to d_n, rather than encoding or decoding a second time.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Remarks explicitly defines this comparison-arrow convention. Supplier def-it-single-letter-distortion-and-block-distortion defines d_n(x^n,hat x^n)=(1/n) sum from t=1 to n of d(x_t,hat x_t), exactly the lower node. It also fixes X^n=(X_1,...,X_n), so the indexing is consistent.

diagram_math_checks.relation: Rate is (log_2 M_n)/n; expected and positive-slack excess distortion remain distinct.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Definition lines 35, 37 and 39 give the message-count rate, limsup expectation bound and every-epsilon positive-slack tail condition. Remarks reproduces these separately. There is no noisy channel, criterion equivalence, exact-threshold condition, or rate-distortion curve shape asserted by the illustration.

diagram_math_checks.proof_independence: This is a definition with no proof section. The full original definition remains byte-identical; its mathematical content and any rigorous arguments using it remain independent of the explanatory figure.
